<!-- Generated by scripts/build.py: Claude fr-FR terminology -->
In fr-FR UI copy and responses, translate these terms exactly as listed:

- Claude Code → Claude Code. Product name. Keep in English in every language, without quotation marks.
- Cowork → Cowork. Product name. Keep in English.
- Remote Control → Contrôle à distance. Keep in English when capitalized as the feature name. Translate lowercase “remote control” used descriptively.
- MCP / MCP server → MCP. Keep the abbreviation MCP; translate “server”.
- desktop app → application de bureau. Keep Claude Desktop and Claude Code for Desktop in English when used as names.
- Dispatch → Dispatch. Keep Dispatch in English as the feature name and on toggles. zh-Hans translates the verb as 派发.
- Session → session. A unit of work in Claude Code and Cowork. zh-Hans: session = 会话, chat and conversation = 对话; never mix them.
- Chat / Conversation → conversation. zh-Hans uses 对话 for both chat and conversation, never 聊天. ja-JP and ko-KR: chat = チャット / 채팅, conversation = 会話 / 대화.
- Side Chat → conversation latérale
- Skill → compétence. zh-Hans and zh-Hant keep Skill in English, never 技能. ja-JP uses the plural Skills.
- Artifact → artefact. Handled differently per language: zh-Hans keeps Artifact, zh-Hant uses 成品, ja-JP keeps Artifacts, ko-KR transliterates as 아티팩트.
- Extension → extension. Distinct from Plugin. zh-Hans: Extension = 扩展, Plugin = 插件; never use 插件 for Extension.
- Computer use → utilisation de l’ordinateur. zh-Hans mostly uses 计算机使用: 21 against 2 for 电脑操作.
- Quick Entry → saisie rapide. Translated in menus and settings; some web strings still keep Quick Entry.
- Developer / Developer mode → mode développeur
- Project → projet
- Memory → mémoire. Claude’s memory feature. Hardware memory is a different word, e.g. zh-Hans 内存.
- Connector → connecteur
- Plugin → plugin. Distinct from Extension. zh-Hans: Plugin = 插件, Extension = 扩展.
- Message → message
- Incognito → incognito
- Style → style. zh-Hans: Claude’s response style = 风格, output style = 输出风格. Official copy uses 样式 for creating custom styles about half the time.
- Routine → routine. zh-Hans mixes 例程 and 例行任务; 例程 is the majority.
- Scheduled task → tâche planifiée / tâches planifiées
- Integration → intégration
- Voice mode → mode vocal
- Knowledge (project knowledge) → connaissances
- Model → modèle. Never translate model names such as Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
- Agent → agent. zh-Hans: AI agent = 智能体, never 代理. 代理 is used only for system components such as the SSH agent.
- Research → recherche
- Thinking / Extended thinking → réflexion
- Prompt → prompt
- Context / Context window → contexte
- Token → token. As an LLM unit, keep lowercase token, e.g. zh-Hans “{count} 个 token”. Authentication tokens are translated, e.g. zh-Hans 令牌.
- Compact → compacter
- Tool → outil
- Web search → recherche web
- Plan mode → mode plan
- Auto mode → mode automatique
- Sandbox → bac à sable
- Folder → dossier. ja-JP mixes フォルダ and フォルダー; フォルダ is the majority. Translate directory separately, e.g. zh-Hans 目录.
- Workspace → espace de travail
- Repository → dépôt
- Worktree → worktree. The git worktree concept.
- Git origin → origine Git. Official translations are inconsistent; the recommendation follows the majority.
- Branch → branche
- Pull request → pull request
- Sign in / Log in → se connecter / connectez-vous. ja-JP keeps the distinction: sign in = サインイン, log in = ログイン.
- Organization / Admin → organisation
- Credentials → identifiants
- Permission → autorisation
- API key → clé API / clés API
- Plan → forfait. The subscription tier, such as Pro or Max. Distinct from plan mode, e.g. zh-Hans 套餐 versus 计划模式.
- Usage / Usage limits → utilisation
- Upgrade → mise à niveau / mettre à niveau
- Subscription → abonnement
- Seat → siège
- Rate limit → limite de débit / limites de débit
- Pin / Pinned → épingler. Pinning an item to the top of a list: zh-Hans 置顶, zh-Hant 釘選, ja-JP ピン留め. Locking a setting, such as a Git origin: zh-Hans 固定.
- Trust / Trusted → faire confiance. trusted folder = zh-Hans 受信任的文件夹.
- Allow / Allowed → autoriser
- Approve / Approved → approuver / approbation
- Fork → dupliquer
- Star / Starred → ajouter aux favoris
- Archive → archiver. An archive file format is a different term, e.g. zh-Hans 压缩文件.
- Share → partager. zh-Hans: 共享 for ongoing access, such as sharing a project or plugin; 分享 for sending content, such as sharing a chat or Skill.
- Attach / Attachment → joindre / joint
- this computer → ordinateur. zh-Hans splits 计算机 and 电脑 almost evenly; 计算机 appears mostly with Computer use. Use 电脑 for the device.
- Phone → téléphone
- Cloud → cloud. Keep names such as Google Cloud.
- Settings → paramètres
- Configuration / Config → configuration. zh-Hans distinguishes settings = 设置 and config = 配置.
- Window → fenêtre
- Terminal → terminal
- Connect / Connected / Connection → connexion / se connecter
- Restart → redémarrer. ko-KR mostly uses 다시 시작, sometimes 재시작.
- Update → mettre à jour. ja-JP uses 更新 in general and アップデート mainly for app version updates.
- Debug / Log → journaux. zh-Hant mixes 偵錯 and 除錯; 偵錯 is the majority.
- Dictation → dictée
